main_idea: On-policy distillation improved GDPval performance across two model families.
ideas: Nemotron gained a +20.9% net win-loss margin.
Qwen gained a +21.4% net win-loss margin and 7.9 rubric points.
On-policy distillation trains on the student's own generations.
summary: The two result cards make the point, while repeated summaries, branding, and a separate process diagram compete for attention.
